capabilities: Read EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and CBZ books in a full-screen reader
Save highlights and notes into the book's Markdown note with links to the passage
Organize books in a library with covers, shelves and collections
Track reading days, streaks and time per book
Import highlights from Annotator, Kindle, KOReader and other apps
extras: All reader features are free; Octavo Cloud is an optional paid subscription for cloud library, send-to-Octavo email, OCR, neural voices, KOReader progress sync and hosted AI. One static ad appears only in the plugin's settings tab, and no telemetry is collected.
intentEvidence: What differs: Octavo stores highlights in the book's Markdown note (one callout per highlight) instead of inside the PDF
problem: Obsidian cannot open EPUB or PDF books, so reading, highlighting and progress tracking happen in separate apps outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Make Octavo your PDF viewer: Settings → Octavo Reader → Library → "Open PDFs in Octavo"
